subject: Compliance follow-up: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter request and Assurance Hub onboarding
messages:
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: alyssa.chen@nexerahealth.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance follow-up: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter request and Assurance Hub onboarding

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about Nexera's roadmap for deploying patient-facing clinical summaries. Per our discussion, wanted to recap the security/compliance next steps and make it as frictionless as possible:

- Request: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) + bridge letter or interim attestation while the next report is in process.
- Access: We can provision read-only access to our Assurance Hub (secure evidence sharing) if that helps with collection — please let me know the two names/emails for access.
- Data regs: You mentioned HIPAA and GDPR obligations — can you surface any specific contractual terms that matter (e.g., data residency, subprocessors)? We can flag those for the security review.
- VSQ: Attached is our Vendor Security Questionnaire template (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). If you prefer, we can have our security team kick off a guided VSQ session.
- Timeline: What timing would work for you to receive the SOC 2 artifacts? Our default is 3–5 business days once portal access is approved.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm two people for Assurance Hub access and preferred email addresses.
2) We grant access and upload the SOC 2 Type II PDF + bridge letter template.
3) Nexera confirms VSQ completion cadence (self-serve vs. walkthrough).

If you want me to loop in our compliance lead to expedite, I can — looping Karthik on this thread to help with technical questions.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

--
This email contains high-level security summary information. For formal evidence we will share artifacts through the Assurance Hub once access is provisioned.

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the VSQ. Quick answers:
- I'll need access for myself (alyssa.chen@nexerahealth.com) and our Security Ops lead, Tom Ruiz (tom.ruiz@procurex.io).
- HIPAA is the primary driver here — we need confirmation around your BAA controls and whether logs/audit trails for admin access are retained 1 year minimum. Also GDPR: we have a couple of EU patients; can you confirm subprocessors and whether data export to third countries is restricted?
- Timeline: If you can get the SOC 2 artifacts into the hub this week, that would be ideal. We have a security review meeting next Tuesday and would like evidence ahead of it.

One more ask — will the bridge letter be on company letterhead and signed? We can accept a scanned PDF for the interim attestation.

Hi all —

Thanks, Alyssa. Quick technical notes from our side:
- SOC 2: We will upload the full PDF (SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2027-06.pdf) to the Assurance Hub. It includes the system description and control narratives.
- Bridge letter: We can provide a signed bridge letter on Redwood letterhead. I'll route to Legal for signature; expect a scanned PDF.
- Audit logs: We retain admin and API audit trails for 18 months by default; we can provide extracts for the period you need.
- Subprocessors: I'll attach our current subprocessors list as part of the hub package and include a short note on data export practices (we do transfer to cloud regions in US/EU as requested).

Monica — can you prepare a short temporary attestation (one-page) that outlines the controls in place for HIPAA and confirm retention windows? Alyssa, that attestation is often helpful ahead of the full report.

-Karthik

Alyssa —

Attached: Temporary_Attestation_Redwood.txt (one-page attestation) and our Bridge_Letter_Template.docx. Quick summary below:

- HIPAA: Redwood operates under a BAA; technical and administrative safeguards are described in the attestation. We tile log retention at 18 months; if you require a custom retention window that can be scoped in procurement.
- GDPR: We support EU region deployments and subprocessors are listed in the hub package (we do not transfer patient identifiers outside agreed regions without contractual approval).
- Bridge letter: Legal will sign the bridge letter; we typically provide a scanned PDF within 2 business days after access is provisioned.

Attachments: Temporary_Attestation_Redwood.txt, Bridge_Letter_Template.docx
